articles.summary: DUBLIN, June 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- GH Research PLC (Nasdaq: GHRS) today announced the publication of the full results from its Phase 2a trial in postpartum depression (PPD) and the acceptance of two oral presentations at the 37th World Congress of Neuropsychopharmacology (CINP 2026).
articles.title: GH Research Announces Publication of Phase 2a Postpartum Depression Results
